Author: Jackoltrade
Name: Better controller experience for FFXIV
Description: Customize DualSense lighting and feel skills, enemy effects and screen shake through vibration. Supports detailed USB DualSense haptics and regular rumble on Bluetooth DualSense or Xbox-compatible XInput controllers.
Punchline: DualSense lighting and haptics, plus regular controller rumble.
DescriptionLoc: 自定义 DualSense 灯光，让自己的技能、Boss 招式和镜头震动更有手感。USB 连接支持触觉反馈，蓝牙 DualSense 和 Xbox 等 XInput 手柄也能用普通振动。
PunchlineLoc: 让手柄体验更爽：DualSense 灯光、触觉反馈，也支持普通手柄。
